openQuestions.question: Does boarding cost anything besides the wait and the ride (no fare is stated)? Can any person ride, or is the cell only, and are there limits for a wanted or recognised cell?
openQuestions.why: GDD §02 prices boarding in time only; anything further is undecided and not set in the timetable.

openQuestions.question: Can a cell be seen or reported while waiting on a platform or riding, which would add Trail or Alert risk to the time price?
openQuestions.why: Watchers stand at stations and stops, but the GDD does not say whether boarding is a witnessed act.

openQuestions.question: Do the T1 and T2 trams and the sky rail run through the whole mission clock, including the 5:40 to 8:00 handover window?
openQuestions.why: Headways are assumed constant; the GDD does not say service changes with Alert or lockdown (the police sealing stations is raised in the plan questions).

notes: T1 and T2 tram speed 8 m/s (~29 km/h): stops are 300 to 310 m apart, so a run takes about 39 s, which keeps a hop short but readable. [S]
S1 sky rail speed 14 m/s (~50 km/h): faster than the trams as an elevated trunk with 200 to 255 m station gaps, so it pays as the cross-city link. [S]
Tram dwell 20 s, sky rail dwell 15 s: dwell is paid only at pass-through stops, so it only affects the 3-stop-plus journeys. [S]
Tram headway 120 s, sky rail headway 90 s: the sky rail is the trunk and runs more often. The average wait is half a headway, so boarding costs 45 to 60 s before the ride. [S]
Journeys use the two interchange pairs T1/circus with S1/circus and T2/harbour with S1/harbour. T1 and T2 do not meet directly, so any tram-to-tram trip goes via the sky rail.
Journeys cover the cases the player will often need: Comet Row to Gardens, Docks to Skyport, Records to Crown Road (three legs), Crown Road to Gardens, and Comet Row to Docks (three legs).
